thread:
Sam K: Quick sync — Horizon Health wants final SLO wording + credit calc today. They asked for clear onboarding milestones tied to latency SLOs.
Anya M: On it. Do we have the onboarding milestones document we promised?
Matt R: I uploaded the onboarding plan to the shared drives last week: https://redwood.app/drive/onboard/horizon-plan v1.2
Sam K: Nice. Main asks from customer: 99.95% uptime SLA, 95th percentile latency < 150ms for generation routes, and a credits formula they can understand.
Julia P: Re onboarding milestones — we can map these to our activation gates: (1) API keys provisioned, (2) model pin + canary, (3) warmup traffic validated, (4) reporting access granted.
Sam K: Exactly. Can we make each milestone gate a measurable signal for the SLO acceptance criteria? e.g., warmup traffic = 10k tokens at p95 < 200ms across 3 zones.
Matt R: That sounds reasonable. For p95 target we can do 150ms after warmup; warmup threshold allows some buffer. I'll pull metrics from last similar onboard (Nebula Labs) to justify numbers.
Anya M: Credit formula suggestion: prorated monthly credit = (downtime_minutes / minutes_in_month) * monthly_commitment * 0.8. Keep simple for legal.
Julia P: Legal prefers % of committed spend rather than linear minutes sometimes. Maybe cap credits per incident. Also need to specify measurement window and who provides evidence.
Sam K: Good call. We should add an evidence bundle step: customer provides request + incident ID, we attach tracing + infra metrics, then CS + SRE approve.
Oncall Bot: Incident 2026-03-18T21:14Z — region eu-west-1 experienced degraded tail latency for 12 minutes. Auto-ticket #INC-8274 created.
Anya M: That bot message will come up in the evidence examples. We should redact internal hostnames before sending.
Matt R: For the reporting doc, I'll draft a one-pager: SLOs, measurement method (route filters, sampling), credit calc example, evidence checklist, and timelines for claims.
Sam K: Who can own the credit calc examples? We need 3 examples: small monthly (<$5k), medium, and enterprise commit.
Julia P: I can do the small and medium templates. Matt can handle enterprise example with reserved capacity math.
Matt R: Yep I'll include dedicated capacity case: credit reductions when Dedicated pool unavailable and fallback to Hosted triggers customer credit plus optional downgrade.
Anya M: Also add guidance on enablement: we should schedule a live walkthrough (30m) to show how to find latency graphs in Console and how to file a claim.
Sam K: Schedule it after the one-pager is shared. Target call: tomorrow 10am PT. Anya, can you own invites?
Anya M: I can. I'll invite Horizon CS lead + their infra eng + our SRE rep (Matt) + Julia for legal ops presence.
Julia P: I'll be on the call for 20m to confirm credit wording. I might drop early.
Sam K: Action list: Matt — draft one-pager + enterprise calc by EOD. Julia — templates for small/medium credits. Anya — calendar + upload onboarding milestones mapping. Me — assemble evidence examples and redaction checklist.
Matt R: Ack. Will ping in this thread with the draft link when ready.
Anya M: Invite sent. Horizon confirmed 10am PT.
Oncall Bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance for telemetry pipeline 2026-03-20T03:00Z — may affect metrics ingestion for up to 30min.
Sam K: Note that maintenance window must be excluded from SLO window in customer docs. Add a footnote.
Julia P: Also include FAQ: "How long after I submit a claim will I see credit applied?" Suggest 30 days standard.
Matt R: Draft uploaded: https://redwood.app/drafts/horizon-slo-onepager-draft — feedback welcome.
Anya M: Reviewing now. Small request: can we include a screenshot of Console latency dashboard focused on generation.route=chat?
Sam K: Yes. Matt, please add a high-res screenshot and callouts for p95 box.
Matt R: Done, updated the draft.
Julia P: PDF-ready language: "Credit eligibility requires timely evidence upload (<=14 days) and no conflicting active rollouts affecting the measured routes."
Sam K: Perfect. After tomorrow's call I'll finalize and ship the doc and an acceptance checklist.
Anya M: Great. I'll capture meeting notes and next steps in the CS ticket: CS-4892.
Matt R: Quick Q — do we want to mention warmup caching behavior (prefix caching) in the onboarding milestone? Some customers are sensitive to cache priming being our responsibility.
Julia P: Call it out: we own server-side prefix cache priming during the warmup window; post-acceptance caching is customer-responsibility (we document cache keys).
Sam K: All right — looks actionable. Anyone see risks for renewal?
Anya M: Slight risk: Horizon wants p95 150ms across international regions; we have region variance at tail during peak. Mitigate by offering a phased SLA with regional ramp and fallback routing.
Sam K: Add a renewal note: tie final SLA to successful canary across their traffic and an improvement plan if p95 doesn't hold after 30 days.
Matt R: I'll include the phased SLA matrix in the one-pager.
Sam K: Thanks all — will sync after the call and attach final artifacts to the account health doc. :thumbsup:
Julia P: :thumbsup:
Anya M: Thanks — see you on the call.
Matt R: +1
thread_short: Sam initiated a final SLO + credit calc sync for Horizon Health; team assigned actions for one-pager, templates, invites, and evidence checklist. Call scheduled 10am PT next day.
